newsitem.title: USA: Kimberly-Clark cuts Huggies package counts.
newsitem.headline: Kimberly-Clark cuts Huggies package counts.

text.p: Kimberly-Clark Corp said Tuesday it is cutting package counts on selected sizes of Huggies diapers and adding adjustable hook-and-loop tabs to the line of Huggies Ultratrim diapers.
The company said it is cutting counts on certain Huggies packages "to match those of a major competitor."
Shipping on the altered diaper begins this month, the company said.
Kimberly-Clark said that despite the cut in package count, the average price of Huggies Ultratrim diapers will be about 12 percent less than it was five years ago.
Kimberly-Clark started the Ultratrim line in 1992. Some of the company's other brands are Pull-Ups, Kotex, Depend, Kleenex and Scott.
